description: A React component implementing a dialog for moving notes between notebooks, including UI for selecting notebooks, handling multi-selection, and managing notebook hierarchy.

classes.name: MoveNoteDialog
classes.description: React component for a dialog to move notes between notebooks, with hierarchical notebook selection and multi-select support.

classes.name: NotebookItem
classes.description: Component representing a notebook item in the hierarchy, with expand/collapse and selection capabilities.

classes.name: SelectedCheck
classes.description: Component displaying selection status (checkbox) for a notebook item.

methods.name: calculateIndentation
methods.description: Calculates indentation for notebook hierarchy based on depth and expandability.

methods.name: createSelection
methods.description: Creates a new selection reference for a notebook item.

methods.name: findSelectionIndex
methods.description: Finds index of a notebook item in the selection array.

methods.name: notebookHasNotes
methods.description: Checks if a notebook contains specific notes.

methods.name: selectSingle
methods.description: Toggles selection of a single notebook.
